card.title: The Incident Keeps Changing
card.instruction: Carry an unnamed past rupture whose meaning shifts with each new detail, while never letting its emotional weight diminish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can give you another concert ticket. That doesn't mean we're past that evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was outside the door the whole time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So it wasn't distance. You were that close and left me alone with it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I heard you say my name. I thought you wanted me to stay out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then what I carried as silence was you listening. I don't know how to hand you this ticket now.

mechanism: A carries an unnamed painful evening whose meaning changes from abandonment to being overheard while the present ticket stays difficult.
confusable: Unlike an incomprehensible mystery, the exact event can remain unnamed but each stated detail must clearly change the relational hurt.
comparison: S228-a reconsiders offering a concert ticket; S228-b asks for company answering a letter after reinterpreting an open envelope.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
